version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: The skill is a clearly disclosed WhatsApp Business integration that uses Maton OAuth and API calls, with appropriate cautions for messaging, credentials, and automation.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires network access, a Maton account, OAuth/browser authorization, and Bash use, which are proportionate for a managed API integration. Raw HTTP with a long-lived API key is documented only as a last resort with handling cautions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed and uses pinned Maton CLI/package versions or a pinned Homebrew install; no hidden install scripts or embedded executable payloads were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill repeatedly narrows agent behavior to documented WhatsApp Business endpoints, defaults to read/list operations, requires explicit approval for writes, connection creation, hosted functions, trigger destinations, and local event execution, and treats third-party content as untrusted data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens are stored in the OS credential store and Maton functions/triggers/destinations can persist beyond a single session, but this is disclosed with approval, least-privilege, deletion, and credential-handling guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities fit the stated purpose: connecting a WhatsApp Business account, reading/listing account resources, sending messages, managing templates/media/profile details, and optionally using Maton functions/triggers for user-approved automation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill can send real WhatsApp messages to real people and may incur business, privacy, or reputation impact. Use it only with the intended WhatsApp Business account, confirm every recipient and write action, avoid broad or persistent automation unless you explicitly need it, and do not expose Maton or provider credentials in files, logs, headers, or prompts.
